disclaimer: Illustrative investigative check shipped with the prototype. It is not derived from any verified or suppressed incident, and a match is not evidence of fraud. Set thresholds from your own policy before use.
name: Change-order approval recorded after work started
description: Flags change orders whose approval timestamp is later than the recorded start of the work they cover, beyond a configured grace period.

graceDays.rationale: Illustrative default of zero; some organisations allow emergency work to start before paperwork. Set to your policy.

conditions.description: Approval is recorded after the work start date plus grace

support.assumption: Retroactive approval removes the chance to reject or re-price the change before cost is incurred.

benignExplanations: Approval entered late into the system although granted verbally in time
falsePositiveConsiderations: Timestamps may record data entry rather than decision time
